#summary HOW-TO: Cross-Compile PARI/GP for Android.
#labels Featured,Phase-Deploy

= Prerequisites =
  * PARI/GP source code.
  * Latest version of the Android SDK and NDK.
   * See [  git clone http://pari.math.u-bordeaux.fr/git/pari.git
  * A working Android development environment.
----
= Fetching the PARI/GP source code =
Use `git` to clone the official PARI/GP repository:
{{{
  git clone http://pari.math.u-bordeaux.fr/git/pari.git
}}}

= Fetching the Android-specific PARI configuration file =

You can download with `wget` (or similar program) if you only want the `pari.cfg` file:
{{{
wget http://paridroid.googlecode.com/svn/pari.cfg
}}}

Or you can use `svn` to check out the entire PariDroid repository:
{{{
svn checkout http://paridroid.googlecode.com/svn/ paridroid-read-only 
}}}

= Cross-Compiling PARI/GP =

You may have to modify the parameter `TOP` in `pari.cfg` to point to the right directory on your machine (and other parameters if you need to), move this file to the top-level directory of your working copy of Pari's source code, then build as usual.

{{{
./Configure -l pari.cfg
cd Oandroid-arm
make -j4 all
}}}

----

= Pushing files to the device =

== Make the directories to hold the files ==

{{{
adb shell
su
cd /data/local
mkdir bin
mkdir lib
}}}

Now `C-c` to get out of `adb shell`.

{{{
adb push gp-dyn /data/local/bin
adb push gp-sta /data/local/bin
adb push libpari.* /data/local/lib
}}}

Once the files are pushed to the phone:

{{{
adb shell
cd /data/local/bin
chmod 0777 gp-sta
chmod 0777 go-dyn
./gp-sta #or gp-dyn
}}}
